interpretation: New family transfer is conditional evidence, not random future accuracy or generalization proof.
selection: First obtainable issue-specific public issuer/exchange documents in each ordered issuer list, with named dated base dependencies; dates no later than 2026-09-30. One issue per category; no expected answer labels. Retain acquisition failures and abstentions. At most three issuer candidates in each category.
stop: A complete retained issue bundle or exhausted candidate budget. Further dependencies may still force abstention; do not replace a case for an unfavorable answer.
